name: Kitami Shuri
source:
The heroine's colleague.
She has quietly supported the earnest heroine from behind the scenes.
She is free-spirited and has a personality diametrically opposed to the heroine's, yet somehow they work well together.
She dotes excessively on her two younger brothers, who are later taken hostage in the latter part of the story.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01002106.html]DLsite[/url]]
